records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue increased for the year ended December 31, 2024, by $52 million, or 2.2%, when compared to the corresponding period of 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average price of Hot-Rolled Coil declined 12.0% (from $887.47 per short ton to $781.00 per short ton) in 2024 compared to 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The price for WTI crude was $74.97 per barrel at January 24, 2025, down 2.1% from the 2024 average.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average price of WTI crude declined 1.4% (from $77.64 per barrel to $76.55 per barrel), and natural gas prices declined 13.8% (from $2.54 per MMBtu to $2.19 per MMBtu) in 2024 compared to 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2024, operating profit was $113 million compared to $140 million for the corresponding period of 2023.
